android.desc:
Explore the quiet, lightweight corners of the internet with DiggieDog, a simple and friendly Gopher client for Android.

Before the World Wide Web took over in the mid-1990s, Gopher offered a fast, organised, text-based alternative for browsing information online. Built around the classic protocol described in RFC 1436, Gopher is still alive and kicking today through hobbyist servers, educational archives, retro computing communities, personal phlogs, software mirrors, documents, and experimental "small internet" projects.

DiggieDog makes it easy to browse Gopherspace from your Android device. Whether you are into retro computing, internet history, minimalist browsing, text-based protocols, or just curious about what exists beyond the modern web, DiggieDog gives you a clean entry point for digging in.

There is still a surprising amount to discover. You just need to dig a little.

Features
* Browse Gopher sites directly from Android
* Simple, lightweight interface
* Explore text-based pages, menus, files, and archives
* Great for retro internet fans, hobbyists, researchers, small web explorers and digital archeologists
* Supports the classic Gopher protocol

DiggieDog is for anyone curious about the internet before everything became feeds, ads, popups, and infinite scroll.

Start exploring Gopherspace today!
